final: WITH income_by_member AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) as combined_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), totals AS (SELECT SUM(combined_amount) as grand_total, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM income_by_member), with_shares AS (SELECT ibm.link_to_member, ibm.combined_amount, ibm.combined_amount * 1.0 / t.grand_total as their_share, 1.0 / t.member_count as average_share FROM income_by_member ibm CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT SUM(combined_amount) as combined_amount, (SUM(combined_amount) * 1.0) / (SELECT grand_total FROM totals) as their_average_share, AVG(their_share - average_share) as average_above_average FROM with_shares WHERE their_share > average_share
